proposals.evidence: Full lavaṇa gives Pali/Prakrit lavaṇa/lōṇa/lūṇa and the regional l/n-initial salt series, including Kalasha lṽŕ, Shina lōəṇ/lūəṇī, Bengali lon/lun/nūn and Marathi loṇ. These support retained lobon, reduced nasal-vowel forms, nwan/nʷãn/nõən and naṇ. Nasal loss or assimilation and local vowels remain qualified; both lobon/nun alternatives belong to this family. Cross-IA transmission is unresolved, not grounds for withholding the family link. Exact response: nõən.
